ecbDepositRate.sourceTitle: ECB key interest rate - Deposit facility
ecbDepositRate.calculation: ECB published deposit facility policy rate in percent per annum, separate from €STR or a term OIS rate. Source daily observations are retained without adding dates.
ecbDepositRate.coverageNote: ECB own daily deposit facility policy rate from 2020, including source-published non-business dates and historical negative rates. It is not €STR or a term OIS rate.
